Detailed Description

Real time partitioned convolution UGen.

The number of channels will be determined by the larger of the number of channels in the impulse Buffer and the input UGen.

PartConvolve::PartConvolve ( UGen const &  input,
Buffer const &  impulse,
long  startPoint = 0,
long  endPoint = 0,
FFTEngine const &  fftEngine = 0 
) throw ()
Parameters:
inputThe input signal to convolve.
impulseThe impulse repsonse to convolve with the input.
startPointThe sample offset into the impulse Buffer to use as the first sample in the convolution (0 is default).
endPointThe sample offset into the impulse Buffer to use as the last sample in the covolution. This is exclusive. A value of 0 means all remaining samples in the Buffer will be used (0 is default).
fftEngineThe FFTEngine to use to do the processing. An FFT size can be specified here to force a particular FFT size of the processing. The defualt of 0 will cause PartConvolve to create its own FFTEngine with a size of 4096.
